text: Use pnpm, not npm or yarn, in this repo. The lockfile is pnpm-lock.yaml and CI fails if a package-lock.json shows up.
Unit tests run with Vitest: `pnpm test` (watch) or `pnpm test:run` (CI mode). Test files sit next to the code as *.test.ts.
E2E tests use Playwright: `pnpm e2e`. They need the dev server on port 3100 and a seeded database (`pnpm db:seed`) first.
Checkout e2e specs are flaky in parallel because the Stripe mock can't handle concurrent sessions; run them with `--workers=1`.
Pricing logic lives in src/lib/pricing/. Never compute prices in React components; call getDisplayPrice() instead.
Server actions go in src/app/**/actions.ts and must validate input with the zod schemas in src/schemas/ before touching the DB.
Styling is Tailwind only, no CSS modules. Merge class names with the cn() helper from src/lib/cn.ts.
Branch names: feat/SF-<ticket>-short-desc or fix/SF-<ticket>-short-desc. The ticket prefix is always SF-.
PRs are squash-merged into main and the PR title becomes the commit, so write the title as a Conventional Commit (feat:, fix:, chore:).
Prisma: edit prisma/schema.prisma, then run `pnpm prisma migrate dev --name <change>`. Never hand-edit files in prisma/migrations/.
Prices are integer cents (priceCents) everywhere. Currency is per store (store.currency); never assume USD.
Node is pinned in .nvmrc (22.x). Run `nvm use` before installing, or pnpm refuses because of the engines field.
Every PR gets a preview deploy automatically. Production is a manual 'Promote' of the preview in the hosting dashboard after QA signs off.
Stripe runs in test mode locally. Start the webhook forwarder with `pnpm stripe:listen`, or orders stay stuck in 'pending'.
Env vars: copy .env.example to .env.local. NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars are shipped to the browser, so never put secrets under that prefix.
Cart state is server-side (cartId cookie + DB). Don't add a client-side cart store like Zustand; it was removed on purpose.
Component tests use @testing-library/react with the custom render() from test/utils/render.tsx, which wraps the i18n and theme providers.
Named exports only. Default exports are allowed only in Next.js page, layout and route files.
Before pushing, run `pnpm check` (typecheck + eslint + vitest run). CI runs the same script.
The storefront ships en, de and fr. UI strings live in messages/<locale>.json; a key missing from any locale fails the build.
Product photos go through src/components/ProductImage.tsx (next/image with the CDN loader). Don't use raw for product images.
Lint autofix: `pnpm lint --fix`. The import-order rule is enforced; don't disable it per file.
Product search uses a hosted index synced nightly by scripts/sync-search.ts. New product fields aren't searchable until the next sync or a manual run.
Feature flags are defined in src/flags.ts and read with useFlag(). Percentage rollouts are set per flag; remove flag code within two sprints of 100%.
Snapshot tests are banned here. Assert on visible text and accessible roles instead.
Tax is calculated by the tax service at checkout, not in the cart. Cart totals before checkout are pre-tax by design.
Local DB: `docker compose up -d db` starts Postgres 16 on port 5433, not 5432, so it doesn't clash with a system Postgres.
Dependencies are managed with uv: `uv add <pkg>` and `uv sync`. Don't pip install into the venv or edit requirements files; they're generated.
Unit tests: `uv run pytest tests/unit -q`. They must not touch the network or the database.
Integration tests (`uv run pytest tests/integration`) need `docker compose up -d postgres redis` first and are marked @pytest.mark.integration.
Alembic: `uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m '<msg>'`, then read the generated file. Autogenerate misses enum value changes; add those by hand.
Format and lint with ruff only (`uv run ruff format`, `uv run ruff check --fix`). black and isort were removed.
Type hints are required on all public functions; mypy runs in strict mode on src/tidewater/ in CI.
Routers in src/tidewater/api/ stay thin: parse the request, call a service in src/tidewater/services/, return a schema. No SQL in routers.
Celery tasks in src/tidewater/tasks/ must be idempotent; the broker can deliver the same task twice.
Timestamps are stored in UTC (timestamptz). Convert to the tenant's timezone only in the API response layer.
Settings live in src/tidewater/config.py (pydantic-settings). Add new env vars there and to .env.example; never read os.environ directly.
Uploads are capped at 50 MB per request. Bigger files must use the presigned-URL flow in src/tidewater/services/uploads.py.
Run the API locally with `uv run fastapi dev src/tidewater/main.py` (port 8000, auto-reload); interactive docs at /docs.
Build test data with the factory_boy factories in tests/factories.py instead of constructing ORM objects by hand.
Commit subject: imperative, ≤ 72 chars, area in brackets first, e.g. '[ingest] Retry on 429 from partner API'.
Deploys run in the CI pipeline: a merge to main deploys to staging; a tag vX.Y.Z deploys to production.
Partner API limit is 600 requests/min per tenant. services/partner_client.py already retries with backoff; don't add another retry layer on top.
Python 3.12 is required; the code uses PEP 695 generics, so older interpreters fail at import.
Tenants are tenant_slug in URLs but tenant_id (UUID) in the DB. Never expose tenant_id in API responses.
Mock outbound HTTP with respx, not unittest.mock on httpx; the partner client uses transport hooks that mock.patch bypasses.
Reprocess a failed batch with `uv run python -m tidewater.cli reprocess --batch <id>`. It is idempotent, safe to run twice.
Report queries live in src/tidewater/reports/sql/*.sql and are loaded by name. Keep SQL there, not in inline Python strings.
Celery beat schedules are in src/tidewater/tasks/schedule.py; the nightly dedupe runs at 02:30 UTC.
Log with structlog's get_logger() and pass fields as kwargs. Never log raw PII such as emails or names; log the user_id instead.
CI enforces 85% coverage on src/tidewater/services/; new service code needs tests in the same PR.
Install the pre-commit hooks with `uv run pre-commit install`; they run ruff and a secrets scan on every commit.
CSV ingest expects UTF-8. Partner files in legacy 8-bit encodings (Latin-1) are converted by src/tidewater/ingest/decode.py, which sniffs the encoding first.
Never force-push main or release/* branches. Rebase your own feature branch and force-push only that, with --force-with-lease.
Use the Makefile: `make build`, `make test`, `make lint`. Tool versions are pinned in tools.go, so don't run a globally installed golangci-lint.
`make test` runs `go test -race ./...`. The race detector is mandatory; CI runs it too.
Integration tests use the `integration` build tag: `go test -tags=integration ./internal/...`. Start etcd and Postgres first with `make deps-up`.
After editing .proto files in api/proto/, run `make proto` (buf generate). Generated code in gen/ is committed; never hand-edit it.
SQL lives in internal/store/queries/*.sql and is compiled with `make sqlc`. Don't write raw database/sql calls.
Wrap errors with fmt.Errorf("doing X: %w", err). Never log an error and also return it.
context.Context is the first parameter of any function that does I/O. Never store a context in a struct field.
Routes are registered in internal/http/router.go. Every new route also needs an entry in config/policy.yaml (authz) or it returns 403.
Upstream calls time out after 2s per hop by default (upstream.timeout); the gateway's overall request deadline is 10s.
Rate limits are per API key, a token bucket in Redis. Limits live in config/limits.yaml and hot-reload without a restart.
Config is YAML in config/, loaded by internal/config. Env vars override with the RG_ prefix, e.g. RG_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT.
`make run` starts the gateway on :8080 (HTTP) and :9090 (gRPC) against the stub upstreams in testdata/stubs.
Go 1.23. Log with the standard library's log/slog; zap is being removed, so don't add new zap loggers.
One logical change per PR. The description links the RG- ticket and lists any config changes ops must apply.
Release with `make release VERSION=vX.Y.Z`, which tags and pushes. CI builds the container image from the tag; never build release images locally.
Write table-driven tests with t.Run subtests. Golden files go in testdata/; refresh them with `go test ./... -update`.
Metrics are Prometheus. New metrics use the rg_ prefix and are registered in internal/metrics/registry.go.
The gateway strips inbound X-Internal-* headers before proxying. Clients can't set them, so never trust them from outside.
`make bench` runs the benchmarks in internal/proxy. Compare runs with benchstat before claiming a speedup.
Middleware order: recover → request ID → auth → rate limit → logging. Add new middleware in internal/http/chain.go at the right position.
Postgres only holds API key metadata. Request and response bodies are never persisted (privacy requirement).
Renovate opens weekly dependency PRs. Don't bulk-update by hand; for a single module use `go get <mod>@<ver>` then `go mod tidy`.
Hotfixes branch from the latest release tag as hotfix/<version>, ship from there, then get cherry-picked back to main.
Per-upstream circuit breaker: opens after 5 consecutive 5xx within 30s, half-opens after 15s. Settings are in config/upstreams.yaml.
